question: Where was the 67th Governing Body Meeting of the Asian Productivity Organization (APO) held in May 2025?
solution:
The Correct answer is __**Jakarta, Indonesia**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **67th Governing Body Meeting** of the **Asian Productivity Organization (APO)** was held in **Jakarta, Indonesia** in May 2025.
 
• The **Asian Productivity Organization (APO)** is an intergovernmental organization committed to enhancing the productivity of its member countries.
 
• **Indonesia**, the host country, is one of the founding members of the APO, which was established in **1961**.
 
• Jakarta, the capital of Indonesia, is a major hub for international conferences and events, reflecting its role as a prominent economic and political center in the **Southeast Asian region**.
 
• The APO Governing Body Meeting is an annual event where delegates from all member countries gather to discuss and plan strategies for **productivity enhancement, innovation, and sustainable development**.
 
• Indonesia has been actively involved in APO programs, focusing on productivity improvement in sectors like **agriculture, manufacturing, and services**.
 
• The event in Jakarta underscored Indonesia's commitment to fostering **regional cooperation** and addressing productivity challenges in the Asia-Pacific region.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Bangkok, Thailand**__

 __
 
• **Bangkok** is the capital and largest city of **Thailand**.
 
• It is known for its **vibrant street life, cultural landmarks, and bustling markets**.
 
• Thailand is also an APO member and has hosted several APO events in the past.
 
 
 
• **Tokyo, Japan**__
 __
 
• **Tokyo** is the capital of **Japan** and serves as the headquarters of the **Asian Productivity Organization (APO)**.
 
• Japan is a key member of the APO and often plays a leading role in its initiatives and programs.
 
 
 
• **New Delhi, India**__
 
 
• **New Delhi** is the capital of **India**, another founding member of the APO.
 
• India has been an active participant in APO initiatives, particularly in areas like **agriculture and industrial productivity**.
